guarantees.note: Six sevens means a 12-card hand can be dealt three each, the maximum the seven allowance permits.

deal.procedure: Shuffle the 24 non-seven cards and deal 9 to each player; shuffle the 6 seven-cards and deal 3 to each. Six cards stay in the pool as spares.
deal.why: A flat random deal from 30 breaks the seven allowance roughly a quarter of the time. Stratifying it also means every test game exercises the maximum-spike case.
